newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada ups CWB 196/97 wheat C$10/T, durum C$10-$30.
newsitem.headline: Canada ups CWB 196/97 wheat C$10/T, durum C$10-$30.

text.p: The Canadian government on Friday approved a C$10 a tonne increase to government-backed partial "initial" payments on wheat marketed by the Canadian Wheat Board in crop year 1996/97 (Aug/July), CWB said.
The only exception to the increase is tough and damp wheat which will only see a C$6 a tonne rise in initial 1996/97 payments, the CWB statement said.

Initial payments are guaranteed by the federal government and represent a significant portion of the expected total return from all sales during the entire crop year. Those guarantees are adjusted as market circumstances warrant.
